scenes.say: Same coffee. Three very different cups.
Ris-tret-toh means restricted. Loon-goh means long. Nor-mah-leh sits between.
Less water, sweeter cup. More water, more bitterness.
A ris-tret-toh isn't a shot stopped early. That tastes sour.
Water keeps pulling flavor. The late flavors are bitter.
Keep your dose the same. Change only the water.
Short is sweeter. Long is more bitter. Save this cheat sheet.
